prompt: A photorealistic photo depicts a sophisticated rooftop terrace at dusk, filled with elegant furniture and guests. On the left, a bartender in a white shirt pours champagne into a flute held by a woman in a silver evening gown. She stands next to a tall potted olive tree, smiling at a man in a navy suit who leans against the glass railing. In the center, a round marble table holds a vase of red roses, a lit candle, and two wine glasses. A waiter carries a tray of appetizers past the table, moving toward a group seated on plush velvet sofas on the right. One guest gestures animatedly while holding a cigar, engaging another who listens intently. String lights hang overhead, casting a warm glow on the scene. The background reveals a sprawling city skyline with illuminated skyscrapers fading into the twilight sky. The lighting is ambient and soft, highlighting the textures of the stone floor and fabric upholstery. Reflections shimmer on the glass surfaces, adding depth. The image captures a moment of urban luxury and social interaction. The style is a photorealistic photo, focusing on accurate material representation and atmospheric perspective.
